item.title: chromium os install -> Failed!
item.description:
Install chromium os… failed…

  1. download usb chromium os.

    • http://chromeos.hexxeh.net/vanilla.php
    • ChromeOS-Vanilla-1217.0.2011_10_25_1632-r9de021da.tar.gz

  2. partition 調査

     cat /proc/partitions

  3. write to usb

         /dev/sdg1
     sudo umount /media/2799-4470
     sudo dd if=/home/[username]/work/20111026.chromium.os.install/dl/ChromeOS-Vanilla-1217.0.2011_10_24_1637-r9de021da.img of=/dev/sdg bs=1k
         →  error...quit!
    • http://www.mimimemo.net/2011/01/chromium-os-zero/
    • install tool
      • USB-ImageWriter

  4. start up from usb to old pc.

  5. install to hdd used usb start up img. http://yanotaka2.wordpress.com/2011/07/08/%E7%B5%90%E5%B1%80%E3%80%81chromeos%E3%82%92hdd%E3%81%AB%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B9%E3%83%88%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AB%E3%81%97%E3%81%A6%E3%81%97%E3%81%BE%E3%81%A3%E3%81%9F%E3%80%82/
